Name: Primordial Warp
Description: You create an arcane sigil before you, and from it produce a burst of prismatic light that targets one creature or point within the spell’s range. Make a ranged spell attack against your initial target, dealing 6d10 force damage on a hit. Each creature within 5 feet of your target must succeed a Dexterity saving throw, taking the same force damage on a failure. If any targets hit by this spell have temporary hit points, an amount of this spell’s damage equal to their temporary hit points is doubled.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 3rd:

• The spell deals an additional 2d10 force damage.
• This spell’s range doubles.
• The range for considering secondary targets doubles.
• This spell is cast as a bonus action instead of as an action.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
